svg.text: Sheet 2 - ESP32-S3 pinout, encoder mux tree, current-sense isolation
All ISO7741 channels run clean -> power (4/0 part).
E-stop sense is a separate opto (Sheet 1).
I2C0 (clean) - mux, IMU + 6 wheel encoders - pull-ups 4.7k -> +3V3_CLEAN
each AS5600 reads a magnet on its wheel shaft (one per drive wheel)
